example_en: All members must abide by the rules of the club.
example_cn: 所有成员都必须遵守俱乐部的规定。

example_en: Interest will accrue on the savings account.
example_cn: 储蓄账户会逐渐产生利息。

example_en: The jury acquitted him of all charges.
example_cn: 陪审团宣判他所有指控均不成立。

example_en: She remained adamant that the deadline could not move.
example_cn: 她坚持截止日期不能更改。

example_en: The new policy had an adverse effect on small businesses.
example_cn: 新政策对小企业产生了不利影响。

example_en: The teacher admonished him for being late again.
example_cn: 老师告诫他不要再迟到。

example_en: The medicine alleviated the pain within minutes.
example_cn: 这种药在几分钟内就缓解了疼痛。

example_en: He never alluded to the argument in his speech.
example_cn: 他在演讲中从未提及那次争吵。

translation: adj. 矛盾的，犹豫不决的
example_en: She felt ambivalent about moving abroad.
example_cn: 对于移居海外，她心情复杂。

example_en: There is ample evidence to support the theory.
example_cn: 有充分的证据支持这一理论。

example_en: The speaker amplified her voice with a microphone.
example_cn: 演讲者用麦克风放大了自己的声音。

example_en: The donor requested complete anonymity.
example_cn: 捐助者要求完全匿名。

example_en: His rude remarks only antagonized the audience.
example_cn: 他粗鲁的言辞只是激怒了观众。

example_en: An expert was asked to appraise the painting.
example_cn: 一位专家受邀鉴定这幅画。

example_en: The rules of the game seemed arcane to newcomers.
example_cn: 这个游戏的规则对新手来说似乎很晦涩。

translation: v. 清楚表达 adj. 善于表达的
example_en: She articulated her proposal with great clarity.
example_cn: 她非常清晰地阐述了自己的提案。

example_en: The trail ascends gradually to the ridge.
example_cn: 小径缓缓上升通往山脊。

example_en: Critics ascribe the success of the film to its cast.
example_cn: 评论家把这部电影的成功归功于演员阵容。

example_en: Many young writers aspire to publish a novel.
example_cn: 许多年轻作家渴望出版小说。

example_en: His assiduous preparation paid off in the interview.
example_cn: 他勤奋的准备在面试中得到了回报。

example_en: The monastery kept an austere daily routine.
example_cn: 修道院保持着朴素的日常作息。

example_en: His avarice eventually destroyed the partnership.
example_cn: 他的贪婪最终毁掉了这段合作关系。

example_en: Quick action averted a serious accident.
example_cn: 迅速的行动避免了一场严重事故。

example_en: He is an avid reader of historical biographies.
example_cn: 他热衷阅读历史传记。

example_en: The puzzle continued to baffle the whole team.
example_cn: 这个谜题一直难住了整个团队。

translation: adj. 贫瘠的；不结果实的
example_en: Nothing could grow on the barren hillside.
example_cn: 贫瘠的山坡上什么也长不出来。

example_en: The outlook for the industry looks bleak.
example_cn: 该行业的前景看起来不容乐观。

example_en: It was a costly blunder that no one noticed.
example_cn: 那是一个没人注意到的代价惨重的错误。

example_en: The good results bolstered everyone's confidence.
example_cn: 好成绩增强了所有人的信心。

example_en: Leaking the data was a serious breach of trust.
example_cn: 泄露数据是对信任的严重违背。

example_en: Business was brisk during the holiday season.
example_cn: 假期期间生意很兴隆。

translation: v. 沉思，忧思 n. 一窝
example_en: Do not brood over mistakes you cannot change.
example_cn: 不要为无法改变的错误而耿耿于怀。

translation: v. 稍微移动；改变主意
example_en: He refused to budge from his decision.
example_cn: 他拒绝改变自己的决定。

translation: adj. 官僚的，繁文缛节的
example_en: The application process was slow and bureaucratic.
example_cn: 申请流程缓慢且充满繁文缛节。

example_en: Her buoyant mood lifted the whole office.
example_cn: 她轻快的情绪带动了整个办公室。

example_en: The lawyer buttressed her argument with statistics.
example_cn: 律师用统计数据支撑自己的论点。

example_en: The flood was the worst calamity in a century.
example_cn: 这场洪水是一个世纪以来最严重的灾难。

translation: adj. 冷漠的，无同情心的
example_en: His callous remarks hurt everyone in the room.
example_cn: 他冷漠的言语刺痛了在场的每一个人。

example_en: She spoke with refreshing candour about her failures.
example_cn: 她以令人耳目一新的坦率谈及自己的失败。

example_en: The oil spill was an environmental catastrophe.
example_cn: 那次漏油是一场环境大灾难。

example_en: His caustic wit made him difficult to work with.
example_cn: 他尖刻的机智让人难以共事。

example_en: The committee voted to censure the official.
example_cn: 委员会投票谴责了这名官员。

example_en: To her chagrin, the flight was cancelled again.
example_cn: 令她懊恼的是，航班又取消了。

example_en: He has suffered from chronic back pain for years.
example_cn: 他常年受慢性背痛困扰。

example_en: Be circumspect when sharing personal details online.
example_cn: 在网上分享个人信息时要谨慎。

example_en: They held a clandestine meeting after midnight.
example_cn: 他们在午夜后举行了一次秘密会议。

example_en: Several small groups coalesced into one movement.
example_cn: 几个小团体合并成了一场运动。

example_en: Please present a coherent argument, not a list of facts.
example_cn: 请给出连贯的论证，而不是罗列事实。

example_en: The town built a statue to commemorate the heroes.
example_cn: 小镇建了一座雕像来纪念英雄。

example_en: The ceremony will commence at nine sharp.
example_cn: 典礼将于九点整开始。

example_en: Success can make a company dangerously complacent.
example_cn: 成功会让公司陷入危险的自满。

example_en: He finally conceded that the plan had failed.
example_cn: 他最终承认计划失败了。

example_en: She took a conciliatory tone during the negotiation.
example_cn: 谈判中她采取了和解的口吻。

example_en: Keep your summary concise and to the point.
example_cn: 把你的总结写得简明扼要。

example_en: The school will not condone cheating of any kind.
example_cn: 学校绝不纵容任何形式的作弊。

example_en: She confided her worries to her closest friend.
example_cn: 她向最要好的朋友吐露了自己的烦恼。

example_en: Tourists congregate around the old clock tower.
example_cn: 游客聚集在古老的钟楼周围。
